items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I was with Roy Eldridge in 1932.

ctx.x: And everybody was much older than you.
Oh, yes. And that did it for me. And then Roy Eldridge heard me.

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Kenny Clarke was in that band.

ctx.x: You were talking about the Eldridge Brothers.
Yeah. Kenny Clarke was in that band.
